title: Chapter 301 How Can I Be A Deserter
content:
Chapter 301 How Can I Be A Deserter

"How did you do it?"

Lu Xue walked to Qin Feng and saw that the phantom was really standing there, still looking ahead with an empty expression.

It was actually solved.

Lu Xue was a little incredible at this moment.

Upon hearing this, Qin Feng laughed and said, "Of course I am impressed by my charm."

Lu Xue:...

At this moment, Lu Xue only felt a little angry.

As if seeing Lu Xue was about to be unable to help it, Qin Feng hurriedly said, "That's right. I told him, let us go, we will have a paid."

"Paid?"

"Yes, it's paid."

Hearing this, Lu Xue was speechless. The guy in front of him was actually a toll collection.

He was obviously dead, but he even ran out to collect tolls. How greedy is he?

However, Lu Xue was also a little lucky. Fortunately, she collected money, not life-seeking. If she was a life-seeking, she might have a white-haired man sent a black-haired man today.

As for money, she is the most in need.

At this time, Xiao Luo and Ao Qing dragged their scarred bodies and slowly walked towards Lu Xue and the others.

"Sister Xue."

"Little Master."

Each person and a dragon, with a little complaint in his eyes.

But I dare not say anything.

Who can make people have a better life?

Sometimes, reincarnation is also a technical job.

Seeing Ao Qing and Xiao Luo come back, Lu Xue threw a elixir that was as crystal clear as pearls to each of them, and then said, "Continue to go."

Seeing the pill, Ao Qing swallowed it in one mouthful without any hesitation.

In just an instant, a familiar warm current flowed throughout the body, and the injuries suddenly began to recover quickly.

Xiao Luo, who was beside him, hurriedly surrendered.

It was not until the injury was completely recovered that Lu Xue set off.

"My master, are we going to run out?"

As he ran, Ao Qing suddenly spoke.

Hearing this, Lu Xue frowned slightly, "Nonsense, why don't you run away? Are you waiting to die here?"

However, Ao Qing shook his head slightly.

"My master, I don't think we should run away."

As soon as these words came out, Lu Xue was stunned, "Why?"

Now all kinds of power and will left by the strong men in the ancient battlefield have begun to riot, and the entire ancient battlefield seems to be in a trend of being destroyed.

At this time, everyone's first reaction must be to run away.

But Aoqing actually said that he shouldn't run away.

This made Lu Xue very puzzled, and at the same time, she also wanted to know what Ao Qing would say.

I heard Ao Qing continue, "Little Master, this is all done by the master. Master is your father. Do you think the master will harm you?"

Hearing this, Lu Xue was silent.

Although Lu Daosheng made her very unhappy and even wanted to sulk, one thing is certain.

That is, his father will never harm her.

"You want to say that my father must have a reason for doing this?"

Ao Qing nodded, "That's it."

Suddenly, Lu Xue stopped.

Seeing this, Xiao Luo and Qin Feng stopped quickly.

"Sister Xue, why don't you run away?"

"Yes, is there any danger ahead?"

Lu Xue did not finish her questions about the two, but just lowered her head and thought.

After calming down, she finally reacted.

Yes, how could my dad hurt her?

Now the ancient battlefield has indeed become countless times more dangerous than the usual ancient battlefield, but often the danger will be accompanied by huge gains.

I have been in the ancient battlefield for so long and I am still in the Immortal Lord Realm.

It seemed a bit embarrassing to escape in such a mess.

After careful consideration, Lu Xue decided to continue to stay in the ancient battlefield.

"Our responsibility is to save the entire fairy world from water and fire. Facing a mere ancient battlefield, you want to escape, how can you achieve great achievements?"

Lu Xue's firm voice echoed in Xiao Luo and Qin Feng's ears.

Suddenly, a blush appeared on the faces of both of them.

They will be the saviors who will save the world in the future. Although the protagonist is not them, they are also part of them. How can they run away when facing difficulties?

The two looked at each other and saw the determination in each other's eyes.

"Sister Xue, I realized it."

"Same for me."

Seeing this scene, Lu Xue nodded with satisfaction, "Well, a child can teach you."

However, as soon as the words were finished, a huge muffled sound rang out from a distance.

The next moment, the earth began to tremble wildly.

The few people looked horrified and turned around and looked at it.

I saw a giant standing tall and upright walking towards here holding a giant sword that seemed to be able to open the sky.

His pace was a little slow, and the trembling of the earth was caused by the giant.

"It's the master of that giant sword!"

Qin Feng said in surprise.

"Sister Xue, what should I do?"

"Huh? Sister Xue?"

"Damn, Sister Xue ran away!"

As soon as the two of them realized, they saw that Lu Xue had already escaped to the distance.

Seeing this scene, the two of them dared not stay where they were, so they hurriedly followed.

"Sister Xue, wait for us!"

Not to mention fighting this giant, just one glance can feel the terrifying aura that overflows from the other person's body.

It's even more terrifying than the peak powerhouse of the Immortal Emperor Realm.

At the same time, outside.

The ancient battlefield was originally isolated from the world and controlled by the four major families.

But now, due to Lu Daosheng's intervention, the entire ancient battlefield has undergone a tremendous change, showing its appearance in the fairy world, and a terrifying strange phenomenon broke out.

"That's the legendary ancient battlefield!"

Someone looked at the dim world in the sky and said in a lost voice.

"Ancient battlefield? What place is this, why have I never heard of it?"

Some people are confused.

Obviously, not everyone knows the ancient battlefield.

Of course, someone came forward to explain this.

Among the waiting and watching, a middle-aged man who looked very elegant said slightly solemnly: "The ancient battlefield is where the first group of top strong men who entered the fairy realm fought."

"Now after endless years, has the ancient battlefield finally reappeared in the world?"

"again?"

"Yes, the ancient battlefield has disappeared for a long time, and almost no one knows where the ancient battlefield is."

As for the ancient battlefield, it has naturally been dominated by the four ancient tribes.

And the people of the four ancient tribes will naturally not be stupid enough to tell outsiders.

Of course, even if someone knows something, it will be useless.

If you want to get involved in the ancient battlefield, unless you have the strength to compete with the four ancient tribes, you should know that even though the Xiao tribe was so low that time, in the fairy world, with the Xiao tribe's background, no one dares to mess with it.

Not to mention the four ancient tribes joined forces.

At this time, outside the ancient battlefield.

Xiao Jing, the elder of the Xiao clan, was like an ant on a hot pan, looking anxiously at the direction of the ancient battlefield and constantly paced around the periphery.

At this time, a figure appeared beside him.

Seeing this, Xiao Jing immediately stepped forward and asked anxiously: "Mr. He, what is this situation? Why did such a huge change occur in the ancient battlefield?"

Xiao Jing wants to cry now.

Not to mention that Xiao Luo, the leader of the younger generation of the Xiao clan, is inside, the most important thing is that Lu Xue is inside.

Who is Lu Xue? That is the biological daughter of Lu Daosheng, the lord of Huangcheng City.

As far as he knows, he is still an only child.

If something unexpected happened to Lu Xue, he would not dare to imagine the consequences.

I'm afraid that the wilderly city lord's anger will spread throughout the immortal world.

This is no joke!
